overall_goal: Heat the pan on the cooker and add oil

goals.description: Prepare the pan and place it on the cooker to heat
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the pan, clears items off its handle, opens the cooker, and places the pan with its lid on the heat.

goals.description: Add oil to the heated pan
goals.rationale: The person fetches the oil, removes the pan lid, and pours the oil into the hot pan.
